reason: A read-only repository setup scanner that inspects project structure and selected configuration files, then reports detected technologies, repository hygiene findings, and setup recommendations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的仓库体检插件，用于扫描项目技术栈、测试配置、文档及开发环境线索并提供设置建议。
summaries.en: A read-only repository inspection plugin that scans project stacks, testing configuration, documentation, and development-environment indicators to provide setup recommendations.

capabilities: Read-only inspection of project directories and selected repository files
Detection of language stacks, testing configuration, documentation, Git, Docker, and database indicators
Generation of setup recommendations for skills and MCP servers
